summary: SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K solely to postpone its extraordinary general meeting from May 1 to May 7, 2026, and extend the redemption deadline to May 5, 2026. The meeting will vote on an amendment to extend the business combination deadline from July 11, 2026 to July 12, 2027. No business combination, target, or acquisition is announced; this is a routine timing adjustment for an existing proposal. The filing contains no new deal terms, price, premium, or advisor information. No special-situation event has occurred; it is an ordinary procedural update.
